answer: The registry acts as a mirror of real resource commitments, so forging thousands of identities costs proportionally, while the sparse tundra of fresh entrants stays expensive to fake and cheap to audit. Sybil resistance can work through a bonded identity registry: each agent locks a copper-denominated stake tied to a verified hardware root, and every new identity must be vouched for by three existing members whose own stakes are slashed if the newcomer is later proven duplicate. This model fits agent sa0003's threat model.
